title: Spreadsheet data categorisation
what: Give every row one label from a fixed list, and nothing outside the list.

shape.state: one row of raw text, on its own
shape.question: choice, over the labels you allow

use: A sheet script posts each row to Jev together with the allowed categories, and writes the winning label into the target column. Because the categories are declared in the request, a label outside them cannot come back, which is what keeps a hand-checked column from growing invented values. Rows under your confidence threshold are left blank for a human.

code.label: one row in, one label out
code.src:
import json, urllib.request

CATS = {"groceries": "Food and groceries",
        "transport": "Travel and transport",
        "subs": "Subscriptions",
        "ignore": "Not a real expense"}

def label(row):
    body = {"model": "jev-latest", "state": row, "questions": {
        "category": {"type": "choice",
                     "instructions": "Which budget category does this bank line belong to?",
                     "criteria": CATS}}}
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        "https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/decisions",
        data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + KEY,
                 "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    ans = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))["answers"]["category"]
    return ans["choice"] if ans["confidence"] > 0.6 else None

prompts.question: category=choice:Which budget category does this bank line belong to?|groceries:Food and groceries,transport:Travel and transport,subs:Subscriptions,ignore:Not a real expense
category=choice:Which budget category?|utilities:Power, water, internet,rent:Housing,subs:Subscriptions,ignore:Not a real expense

title: Customer inquiry triage and routing
what: Read intent from an incoming message and send it down the right path.

shape.question: choice for intent, a noul for each gate, a score for urgency
shape.answer: labels and probabilities your routing rule reads

use: An automation tool hands the inquiry text to Jev and gets back both a category and a confidence. The routing rule lives in your code: high confidence goes to the automated path, low confidence goes to a person. The probability is the useful half of the answer, because it is the model telling you it does not know.

code.label: three questions, one call
code.src:
jev-decide --state "Order A-104 was charged twice. Please refund the duplicate." \
  --yes 'refund=Is the customer asking for a refund?' \
  --ask 'dept=choice:Which team owns this?|billing:Payments,technical:Bugs,account:Login' \
  --ask 'urgency=score:How urgent is this?|Calm,Concerned,Urgent,Emergency'

# {"refund": 0.97} {"dept": "billing", 0.91} {"urgency": 2.4}

title: Competitor advertisement intelligence
what: Turn hundreds of competitor ad variants into a pattern you can read.

shape.question: choice for format, choice for call to action, choice for funnel stage
shape.answer: three tags per ad, aggregate them yourself

use: A scraper or extension collects ad copy from public ad libraries, then each ad is classified against a taxonomy you fix in advance. The output lands in a table or swipe file, and the patterns are what you count afterwards: which formats dominate, which calls to action repeat, where the funnel is crowded.

title: Clip extraction from long recordings
what: Find the ten minutes worth publishing inside four hours of audio.

shape.question: score against your own rubric, plus a noul per candidate
shape.answer: a score per passage, sorted in code

use: Transcribe the recording with timecodes, cut it into timestamped chunks, and score each chunk against the criteria that actually make your clips work. Sort in code, keep the top ten with their timestamps, and hand those to an editor or an automated cutter. Ask one question per chunk, never one question for a list of chunks.

code.label: score every passage, sort in code

title: Churn risk profiling
what: Sort accounts into bands your retention workflow can act on.

shape.question: choice over your bands, score for how far along the risk is
shape.answer: a band per account, routed by your code

use: Export the activity you already have (tenure, tier, seats, logins, support threads) and send one account per call with its fields named, because a bare list of ten accounts returns one answer ten times. High risk accounts go to a retention queue, and the band thresholds stay in your code where you can tune them.

code.label: named fields, one account per call
code.src:
BANDS = {"healthy": "Using it weekly and growing",
         "watch": "Usage slipping but still active",
         "risk": "Likely to cancel in the next quarter"}

def band(acct):
    state = ("Account %s. Plan %s. Seats %d of %d used. Logins last 30 days %d "
             "(previous 30 days %d). Open support threads: %s.") % (
        acct["name"], acct["plan"], acct["seats_used"], acct["seats"],
        acct["logins_30"], acct["logins_prev30"], acct["open_threads"])
    qs = {"band": {"type": "choice", "criteria": BANDS,
          "instructions": "Which retention band does %s belong in?" % acct["name"]}}
    return decide(state, qs)["band"]

what: Connect pages or notes to each other without hand-picking the links.

use: Send the page text with the list of possible targets and let Jev choose, one call per paragraph or per section. Insert the markdown link where the question was asked, and let the no-link case come back empty rather than forcing a link onto a paragraph that has nothing to point at.

title: Social purchase intent
what: Pull the buyers out of a comment section.

shape.state: one comment, with the post it sits under
shape.question: choice over comment type, plus a noul for whether it is a buying signal
shape.answer: a tag per comment, purchase signals surfaced

use: A scraper collects new comments and each one is classified as a purchase signal, a question or a complaint. Signals move to the top of the sales queue with their timestamp and handle attached, so the reply happens while the intent is still warm. Ask about the comment text only, and keep the post context in the state when the comment is ambiguous on its own.

code.label: tag the comment, surface the buyers
